name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.9: remote visibility for placed machines. Adds POST /machines/:deviceCode/logs (machine key) so a kiosk can post its own logcat lines, stored as a rolling window per machine (7 days or 4000 lines, whichever bites first) and readable from the dashboard, because a placed machine has no durable shell. Adds sync_price_tags to the command allow-list with an optional force flag that bypasses the apps record of what it believes is on each LED tag, plus buttons on the Controls tab. Adds read_temp for an on-demand temperature reading. The Controls tab now leads with cabinet temperature (moved from Activity, with a read-now action), then shelf price tags on coil machines, controls, and the machine log with copy-all. The machine header now always states the running app version, including when unknown, and a posted log batch refreshes that version. Cumulative over v6.8.1.
